title: Indian Everyday Masala
body:
The everyday Indian spice palette - keep these on hand:
- turmeric
- chili powder
- coriander powder
- garam masala
- kasoori methi
- chicken masala

title: Saudi Kabsa Spice Blend
body:
- 1 tsp paprika
- 1 tsp freshly ground black pepper
- 1 tsp ground cardamom
- 1 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1 tsp ground cumin
- 1 tsp ground coriander
- 1/2 tsp ground nutmeg
- 1/2 tsp ground cloves

Chopped parsley, to serve (optional).

title: Yemeni Mandi Spice Blend
body:
Whole-spice blend:
- 2 tsp whole coriander seeds
- 1 tsp whole cloves
- 6 green cardamom pods
- 1 1/2 tsp cumin seeds
- 1 cinnamon stick
- 1 tsp whole black peppercorns
- 1/2 tsp ground turmeric

title: Palestinian Musakhan Spice Blend
body:
- 2 tbsp sumac, plus more for serving
- 2 1/4 tsp ground allspice
- 2 tsp ground coriander
- 1 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1 tsp ground ginger
- 1 tsp ground cardamom
- 1 tsp freshly ground black pepper
- 4 tsp Diamond Crystal kosher salt (use half as much by volume for table salt, or the same by weight)

title: Moroccan Ras el Hanout
body:
- 1 tbsp ground cumin
- 1 tbsp ground coriander
- 1 tbsp ground ginger
- 1 tsp black pepper
- 1 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1/2 tsp ground allspice
- 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper

title: Ethiopian Berbere
body:
- 2 tsp coriander seeds
- 1 tsp cumin seeds
- 1/2 tsp fenugreek seeds
- 1 tsp black peppercorns
- 2 whole allspice berries
- seeds of 4 green cardamom pods
- 4 cloves
- 5 dried red chilies, seeds and membranes removed and broken into small pieces
- 3 tbsp sweet paprika
- 1 tsp turmeric
- 1 tsp kosher or sea salt
- 1/2 tsp ground ginger
- 1/4 tsp nutmeg
- 1/4 tsp cinnamon

Toast the whole spices, then grind together with the ground spices.

title: Peri Peri Seasoning
body:
- 2 tsp (8g) garlic powder
- 1/2 tsp (0.5g) onion powder
- 1/2 tsp (1g) ground cumin
- 1 tsp (1g) coriander powder
- 1 tsp (4g) lemon pepper seasoning
- 2 1/2 tsp (5g) smoked paprika
- 1/2 tsp (1g) cayenne powder
- 1 tbsp (11g) kosher salt
- 1 1/2 tsp (10g) granulated sugar

title: Harissa
body:
- 7 dried New Mexico or Guajillo chiles (or a mix of New Mexico and another dried hot chile such as de arbol or chipotle)
- 6 oz jarred roasted red peppers, drained, rinsed and dried (2 large peppers)
- 2 tbsp tomato paste
- 4 large garlic cloves, peeled
- 1 tsp caraway seeds, toasted and ground
- 2 tsp ground coriander
- 2 tsp ground cumin
- 1 tsp smoked paprika
- 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper
- kosher salt
- juice of 1 large lemon (about 2 tbsp)
- 2 tbsp quality extra virgin olive oil, plus more for storing

title: Jamaican Jerk
body:
- 1 1/2 tbsp allspice berries
- 1 1/2 tsp black peppercorns
- 4-5 scotch bonnet peppers (red or orange)
- 3 scallion stems, chopped
- 4 garlic cloves, roughly chopped
- 1 1/2 tbsp fresh thyme leaves
- 2 tsp kosher salt
- 1/4 cup neutral oil
- 2 tbsp brown sugar
- 1 tbsp soy sauce

Grind the allspice and peppercorns, then blend with everything else into a smooth marinade. Enough for 1 whole chicken, thighs, or cut pieces.

See the full Jerk Chicken recipe under Recipes.

title: Thai Khao Soi Curry Paste
body:
Curry paste:
- 2 black cardamom pods
- 1 1/2 tbsp coriander seeds
- 0.75 oz ginger, thinly sliced
- 1 1/2 inch fresh turmeric (about 5g), thinly sliced, or 1 tsp ground turmeric
- 1/2 cup shallots, sliced 1/4-inch thick
- 0.75 oz mild dried chilies, such as guajillo or puya
- 1 tsp coarse salt

See the full Khao Soi recipe under Recipes.

title: Thai Gai Yang Marinade
body:
- 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, plus lime wedges for serving
- 3 tbsp grated palm sugar or light brown sugar, packed
- 3 tbsp fish sauce
- 2 tbsp Thai-style thin soy sauce (such as Healthy Boy)
- 1 tbsp dark soy sauce
- 1 small bunch cilantro (about 1 oz), leaves and stems separated
- 2 stalks lemongrass, lower pale stalks minced (about 1/3 cup / 30g)
- 8 garlic cloves, peeled and lightly smashed
- 2 red or green Thai bird chiles, thinly sliced
- 1 1/2 tsp ground white pepper
- 1 tsp ground coriander

For 4 chicken leg quarters (about 2 1/2 lb). Blend into a marinade; grill with 1 to 1 1/2 tbsp canola oil.
